subject: Expanding to Team Insights — options for commit tiers & blended per-token pricing
messages:
From: Alden Morris <alden@paywell.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@paywell.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Launching Team Insights — high-level consumption & pricing ask

Neha / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — Team Insights looks promising. A quick framing from our side so you can advise on the best commercial approach: we plan to onboard three additional internal teams (Customer Insights, Risk Ops, and Product Analytics) over the next two quarters. The new product will use dense embeddings for similarity and a short-form summarization flow for notifications. Ballpark forecast: 1.8–2.5B generated+embedding tokens/mo by Q4 on steady state.

Our procurement has asked for two pieces:
- A committed pricing path (monthly/annual commit) that lets us secure a meaningful per-token rate for projections in the 2B range.
- Option to expand/add incremental teams (and workloads) without renegotiating every time — ideally a predictable add-on pricing model or blended rate for expansion months.

Can you send a proposal that shows: 1) blended per-token price tiers at 0.5/1/2B; 2) incremental commit add-on pricing (e.g., +X% discount for additional teams tied to an incremental commit); and 3) whether you can offer short-term usage credits for the first 60–90 days of onboarding? Also need SOC2 evidence and a sample invoice for procurement.

—Alden
Head of Platform Partnerships
PayWell

Attachments: none

From: neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com
To: Alden Morris <alden@paywell.com>
Cc: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@paywell.com>, markus_klein@redwood-inference.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 21:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Launching Team Insights — high-level consumption & pricing ask

Alden — thanks for the clear framing and numbers. Really helpful. High level response: we can accommodate both a committed tier (predictable per-token pricing) and a predictable incremental add-on mechanism for new teams.

I attached a draft pricing worksheet (PW-pricing-draft-Jun5.xlsx) that shows two commercial paths side-by-side:
- Committed tiers: 0–0.5B, 0.5–1B, 1–2B, >2B tokens with stepped per-token rates.
- Incremental commits (add-on): a blended top-up rate that applies when you increase committed capacity to cover new teams mid-term; the worksheet models +10% / +7% / +5% marginal discount depending on the size of the incremental increase.

We can also offer an onboarding credit structure: 3 months of consumption credits (applied as invoice credit) that scale with the commit level — intended to offset dual-running costs during migration.

I'll loop in Markus (he's on infra & capacity) for technical sizing and Dev from finance/legal for DocuSign & invoice examples. If helpful, let's schedule a 30-min commercial + infra call next week to walk the spreadsheet line-by-line.

Next steps I propose:
1) We firm up a target commit range (e.g., initial 1B commit with incremental trigger to 2B).
2) Redwood sends a redlineable SOW + example invoice and SOC2 summary.
3) Pilot window & onboarding credits are formalized in the SOW.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales (Hosted & Dedicated)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PW-pricing-draft-Jun5.xlsx

From: markus_klein@redwood-inference.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Alden Morris <alden@paywell.com>, Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@paywell.com>, dev_patel@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2026 02:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Launching Team Insights — high-level consumption & pricing ask

Alden / Neha — quick technical-commercial note from infra:

1) Workload profile matters for unit economics. Embeddings-heavy workloads can be optimized with prefix caching and batched embedding pipelines; we typically see 25–40% lower token cost after applying batching and caching recommendations. We'll include model/quantization suggestions in the SOW.

2) For the ~2B tokens/mo footprint you quoted, Dedicated pools (reserved) or our higher-tier committed-hosted plan will give the best predictable price and SLA. We can guarantee throughput and a routing policy that keeps your latency consistent across teams.

3) Commercial ask: if PayWell commits to a 2B/month target (or a 1B baseline with an automatic trigger to 2B at month N), we can offer a stepped incentive: 12% off per-token at 1–2B baseline, 16% off at a firm 2B commit, plus a one-time onboarding credit equal to 5% of the first three months' estimated spend.

I'll prepare a short appendix listing the technical knobs that materially affect price so procurement understands the levers.

—Markus
Head of Serving Runtime & Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Alden Morris <alden@paywell.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@paywell.com>, markus_klein@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 10:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Launching Team Insights — high-level consumption & pricing ask

Neha / Markus — this is very helpful, thank you. A few clarifying questions from procurement and engineering:

- Can you provide explicit breakpoint per-token numbers in the spreadsheet (we need line items we can plug into our forecast)?
- For incremental add-ons: is the marginal blended rate applied retroactively for the billing period or only going forward? Procurement prefers retroactive application for month-level smoothing.
- SOC2 evidence: please send the one-page summary and a link to the audit portal.
- DocuSign: send the SOW + pricing via DocuSign for signature so procurement can route to legal.

Also: our engineering team will expect a short operational runbook for onboarding (cache warm-up, batching settings, suggested model variants). Can you include that in the SOW appendix?

If we can get a clear numbers table + SOW link by end of day Wednesday we should be able to route this through procurement for an EOM signature target.

Thanks —
Alden
Head of Platform Partnerships
PayWell

From: dev_patel@redwood-inference.com

Subject: Re: Launching Team Insights — high-level consumption & pricing ask

Alden / Sofia — attaching a redlineable SOW + sample invoice and SOC2 one-pager as requested. Highlights:

- Breakpoints: spreadsheet now includes explicit per-token rates for 0–0.5B, 0.5–1B, 1–2B, and >2B. The incremental add-on is modeled to apply pro-rata for the billing month (retroactive application is supported for monthly invoices if documented in the SOW).
- Onboarding credits: we propose credits applied as invoice line items for months 1–3; credit is sized to the commit level and will show on the sample invoice.
- Term & escape: 12-month core commitment with a 60-day exit for material breach; standard data & security terms included.
